7月14日，据信由总部设在南京的亲日组织“大民会”浦东支部派遣的人员，在浦东各主要街道张贴了下列含有反英、反蒋介石将军及反共宣传内容的传单：
(1) 题为《以建立东亚新秩序纪念七七周年》的传单，声称亚洲属于亚洲人，应消除白种人的剥削与侵略。
(2) 题为《铲除共产主义可实现东亚永久和平》的传单，谴责共产党人为世界和平的破坏者。
(3) 题为《七七事变是因英国剥削蒋政权而造成的悲剧》的传单，指控英国煽动了当前的中日敌对行动。
(4) 题为《值此七七周年之际告全国劳工同胞书》的传单，指责英国应对过去在中国领土上发生的事件中中国劳工被屠杀一事负责。他们还因援助蒋介石将军而导致中日敌对行动延长，并造成大量工人失业。该传单引用浦东中华印刷厂（China Printing and Finishing Company）目前的罢工事件称，由于“新中国政府”的援助，罢工者得以坚持斗争。

July 11, 1939. Morning Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

LOCAL OFFICE OF GREAT PEOPLE'S ASSOCIATION HOLDS MASS
MEETING TO COMMEMORATE LUKOUCHIAO INCIDENT

At 10 a.m. July 10, the local office of the
Great People's Association held a mass meeting at its
premises on Seward Road in commemoration of the second
anniversary of the Lukouchiao Incident. Some 400 persons
were present.
Li Ngoh-kwan (李玉昆), Chief of the local
office of the Association, delivered the following opening
address :-
"Being of the same civilization and race,
China and Japan should be friendly and co-operate in
resisting Britain and Soviet Russia. Unfortunately,
the Lukouchiao Incident occurred in 1937 and fighting
has since continued. During the past hundred years,
Britain, Soviet Russia and other foreign countries have
invaded China by military, political, economic and cultural
means; they have taken our territory, controlled our
Customs administration and manipulated our commerce and
our finances. As a consequence, our country is on the
verge of ruin and the people are in the most distressful
condition.
"Being closely connected with the fate of
China, Japan cannot sit by and watch the failure of the
Kuomintang Government. Instead of opening sincere
negotiations with Japan, China believed in the assistance
of Britain, Soviet Russia and other foreign countries
and opened the war with the friendly nation with the
result that the two countries have suffered huge losses.
"The people must come to their senses quickly
and stop the Sino-Japanese hostilities in order to prevent
the British from getting all the benefit. In
commemoration of the Lukouchiao Incident, all of us must
do our best for the construction of peace in East Asia
for the welfare of the yellow people."
At the end of the meeting, a procession of
the participants took place, during which, handbills
were distributed.

Another Meeting Held : Slogans Shouted

At 3 p.m. July 10, the Third Branch of the
local office of the Great People's Association held a
meeting in the auditorium of the Chamber of Commerce,
North Soochow Road, at which some 600 persons including
representatives of various labour unions were present.
Chen Chung-hua (陈中华), Chief of the Branch, presided.
Under the leadership of Chen Chung-hua, the
following slogans were shouted :-
1) Support the "Reformed Government"!
2) Construct a new order in East Asia!
3) Don't forget the anniversary of the Lukouchiao Incident!
4) Annihilate the Communist Party!
5) Overthrow the British Imperialists!
6) Recover the British Concessions in China!
7) Long live the friendship between China and Japan!
8) Long live the "Reformed Government"!

大民会地方办事处举行群众大会纪念卢沟桥事变

7月10日上午10时，大民会地方办事处在其西华德路址内举行群众大会，纪念卢沟桥事变二周年。约有400人出席。
该会地方办事处主任李玉昆（Li Ngoh-kwan）致开幕词如下：
“中日同文同种，本应友好合作，共同抵抗英国和苏俄。不幸的是，1937年发生了卢沟桥事变，战事自此持续不断。在过去的一百年里，英国、苏俄及其他外国通过军事、政治、经济和文化手段入侵中国；他们侵占我国领土，控制我国海关行政，操纵我国商业和金融。结果，我国濒临灭亡，人民处于最困苦的境地。
“日本与中国的命运息息相关，不能坐视国民党政府的失败。中国不信赖与日本进行真诚谈判，反而相信英国、苏俄及其他外国的援助，并与友邦开战，导致两国遭受巨大损失。
“民众必须迅速觉醒，停止中日敌对行动，以防止英国坐收渔利。在纪念卢沟桥事变之际，我们所有人都必须为东亚和平建设及黄种人的福祉竭尽全力。”
会议结束时，与会者举行了游行，期间分发了传单。

1) 拥护“维新政府”！
2) 建设东亚新秩序！
3) 勿忘卢沟桥事变周年！
4) 消灭共产党！
5) 打倒英帝国主义！
6) 收回在华英租界！
7) 中日友谊万岁！
8) “维新政府”万岁！

Mr. Wang Ching Wei, leader of the Kuomintang,
left Chungking for Han**〔此处转录不清〕**i during December, 1938 with

war of resistance and the Bolshevization of China

by Foreign Powers in this war of resistance and strive

The book entitled "The History of the Treacherous Policy
of Great Britain towards China" which consists of 30 pages, is
strongly anti-British; it asserts that the modern history of
China is the history of treachery perpetrated by Great Britain
on China. Great Britain, it continues, has frustrated many
Chinese revolutions, advocated the partitioning and joint
control of China by the Powers, and also instigated hostilities
in Eastern Asia. The Kuomintang, apparently having forgotten
the story of the Opium War a hundred years ago - the source of
China's sorrow - now condemns Japan for poisoning Manchuria and
North China with narcotics. Judging from what Great Britain
has done to China in the past, the Chinese cannot expect any
favour from her and it is only a myth that Great Britain would
support China and the Kuomintang in waging the war of resistance.
The Chinese people hate the Japanese for forming the "Manchukuo"
but show no objection to an independent state being set up in
Thibet, just as they were unmoved by the establishment of a
"Republic" in Mongolia. There is no doubt that China has been
tricked by Great Britain just as she was hoodwinked by the
U.S.S.R.. The rise of Japan to prominence in Asia has created
serious embarrassments to British interests in China. In
an attempt to upset this state of affairs, Great Britain first
advised China to further the campaign of anti-Japanese education,
and later coerced her into a fight with Japan. It is indeed
humiliating to think that China should once again tricked by
the chicanery of Great Britain and her juggling policies. In
support of his argument, the author quotes in his book the history
of the Opium War, the Tai-ping Rebellion, the May 30th Incident
and the invasion of Thibet. On the last page of the book the
following particulars appear:-
*Published on December 1, 1938
*Author: Chien Ching Kuh ( 錢今島 )
*Published: China Economic Society, 5th floor, No.28,
Tuh Po Street ( 德輔道 ), Hongkong.
*Sales Agents: Various bookstores in China.
* Price: $0.15.

题为《英国对华奸诈政策史》一书，共30页，具有强烈的反英色彩；该书声称中国近代史即是英国对中国施行奸诈行径的历史。书中接着指出，英国挫败了多次中国革命，鼓吹列强瓜分并共同控制中国，还煽动东亚的敌对行动。国民党似乎已忘记了一百年前鸦片战争的故事——那是中国悲痛的根源——如今却谴责日本在满洲和华北投放毒品毒害民众。鉴于英国过去对中国的所作所为，中国人不能指望从英国得到任何恩惠，所谓英国会支持中国和国民党进行抗战纯属神话。中国人民因日本建立“满洲国”而憎恨日本，但对于在西藏建立独立国家却未表示反对，正如他们对在蒙古建立“共和国”无动于衷一样。毫无疑问，中国既被苏联蒙蔽，也同样被英国欺骗。日本在亚洲的崛起给英国在华利益造成了严重困境。为了扭转这一局面，英国先是建议中国推进反日教育运动，随后又胁迫中国与日本开战。想到中国再次被英国的诡计和玩弄权术的政策所欺骗，实在令人屈辱。为了支持其论点，作者在书中引用了鸦片战争、太平天国起义、五卅惨案以及入侵西藏的历史。在书的最后一页列有以下详情：-

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by C. Gonsalves. S.I.

Sin Shun Pao

FILE

In connection with the 2nd anniversary of
the Lukouchiao incident, a statement issued by Fu Siao-
en (傅筱菴), Mayor of the "Shanghai City Government",
is quoted in Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper
on July 7, 1939. This statement denounces the
alliance of General Chiang with the communist party
which was responsible for the creation of the Lukouchiao
Incident. It states that General Chiang and the
Communist Party will never win the war because of
their lack of financial strength, and that the
Chinese guerillas cannot help the war of resistance
but will do much harm to the people. Finally, it
advises the people not to be sympathetic towards the
policy of General Chiang and the Communist Party,
but to co-operate with Japan and the new regime in
order to establish a "New Order in East Asia."

On the same day, a speech was also broadcasted
from the Great Shanghai Broadcasting Station, call
sign X.C.J.B., K.C.900, Hardoon Building, Nanking Road,
by Ling Chun An (林炯), Chief of the Propaganda
Department of the "Great People Society". In this
speech, Ling Chun An stated that the Sino-Japanese
incident is not a problem between China and Japan,
but is a conflict between Red and White Imperialists
and the oppressed people in East Asia, therefore the
influence of the European races must be eliminated.
He accused General Chiang of having started the war
of resistance at the instigation of Britain and Russia,

A PROCLAMATION TO PEOPLE

Mr. Wang Ching Wei, leader of the Chinese Kao Ming Tang left
Chungching to Honan last December.

In order to save China from the havoc of war, he made several
appeals stating that Peace is the only way to solve the recent Sino-Japanese
conflict.

Despite the difficulties & danger, he insists his policy.

Do we all Chinese not appreciate his LOYALTY?

With the anniversary of our "Dai Ming Wei", we should deter-
mine to fight against the Communism that will destroy the whole China
to pieces.

Furthermore, we should not get ANY helps from Third Power.

With combination & firm standing, we try to reach the Goal of
RECONSTRUCTION OF NEW ASIA.

July, Ming Kuo Twenty-eighth year
Dai Ming Wei Hangchow Branch

粗略翻译

告民众书

中国高明党领袖汪精卫先生去年十二月离开重庆前往河南。

为了使中国免于战祸，他多次呼吁，指出和平是解决近期中日冲突的唯一途径。

尽管困难重重且危险相伴，他仍坚持其政策。

难道我们所有中国人不感激他的忠诚吗？

值此“大民会”周年之际，我们应决心对抗将使整个中国分崩离析的共产主义。

此外，我们不应寻求任何第三国的帮助。

通过团结和坚定立场，我们力求实现重建新亚洲的目标。

民国二十八年七月
大民会杭州支部
